title: Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole
abstract: arXiv:2610.00233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $\beta$. As $\beta$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $\beta = 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temp

translated_title: 鲁棒即显著：知情的对抗者将最优信号推向显著性极点
translated_abstract: 当知情的对抗者与受限信号通道的受众共享信息时，最能保护真相的信号就是最能描述真相的信号。在108个验证性项目上，对抗鲁棒的最优解与先前工作中的显著性极点完全一致。在20万个项目的池中，两者仅在2,748个项目上存在差异——这些差异恰好出现在先前“显著性到贝叶斯”坐标未定义之处。在坐标已定义的地方，鲁棒性是通过从贝叶斯判别完全转向显著性来实现的。我们通过在一个强迫选择任务（抽象自游戏《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》）中引入对抗者来证明这一点。该对抗者知道目标、观察信号，并使用说服预算 β 为最有力的错误答案进行论证。随着 β 增大，最优信号从后验最大化的选项转向边际最大化的选项；当 β = 0 时，该博弈重现了带有听者温度的原始神谕模型……
tldr: 该研究在信号博弈中引入一个拥有说服预算的知情对抗者，发现对抗鲁棒的最优信号与显著性极点完全重合，且随着说服预算增大，最优信号从贝叶斯后验最大化转向边际最大化。
en_tdlr: Introducing an informed adversary with a persuasion budget into a signalling game shows that the adversary-robust optimal signal coincides exactly with the salience pole, shifting from posterior-maximizing to margin-maximizing choices as the budget grows.
